verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch operations, such as batch payouts or multi-item API calls, are a fair axis for a payments API platform like MoonPay. However, the evidence documents only single-transaction flows: one quote, one buy frame, one payment method at a time. Nothing describes acting on many items at once, and per-item SDK methods are only building blocks for constructing bulk behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
